pattern: 少なくとも（すくなくとも）
purpose: Set a lower bound on an amount or a claim.
keywords: Completion will take at least three days.
At least I support that proposal.
Let us at least take water.
restrictions: May state a numerical minimum or the narrowest claim the speaker can support.
mistake: It establishes a minimum, not an exact total.

segments.role: Set a lower bound on an amount or a claim. 少なくとも + quantity / clause

examples.translation: Completion will take at least three days.
